description: This Java class represents a command to delete a resource from a policy within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for its attributes.

classes.name: DeleteResource
classes.description: Immutable class representing a command to delete a resource from a policy, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label of the PolicyEntry associated with this delete command.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the ResourceKey identifying the resource to delete.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId of the policy containing the resource to delete.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to the resource to be deleted.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the command's payload data to a JSON object builder, respecting the schema version and filter predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DeleteResource with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for object equality based on fields and superclass equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the object's fields and superclass.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation including class name and key attributes.
